method:
Record every journal note under nine native appearance combinations in mGBA.

Valid private SRAM profile records unlock the entire catalogue solely to inspect
its UI. These are disclosed catalogue fixtures, not earned discoveries. Ordinary
A/B/L/R/D-pad controls open and browse the real cabinet. Terrain, enemy state,
VRAM, palettes, OAM and framebuffers are never assigned. Contact sheets append
labels outside untouched native240x160 framebuffers.
fixtures: Private valid serialized journal profiles unlock24items/9enemies for catalogue coverage only. These are not claimed as earned discoveries.
Private valid serialized appearance records select all3frame constructions×3palettes before ordinary startup.
Player coordinate/facing placement on actual accessible cabinet approach; ordinary Up/A interaction opens real journal.
Every selection uses ordinary L/R/A/B/D-pad controls. No UI cursor, geometry, enemy state, palette, VRAM, OAM or framebuffer writes.

entries.name: Sword
entries.description: A hopeful little blade. Deals 2 HP per hit. Cuts bushes and bats seeds back.

entries.name: Bark Shield
entries.description: Hold it toward a threat. Blocks frontal bites and seeds. Your back stays exposed.

entries.name: Gilded Shield
entries.description: Green wood and gold trim. Uses the same frontal guard as the Bark Shield.

entries.name: Blightseeds
entries.description: Set one and stand clear. The blast opens cracked walls and deals 8 enemy HP.

entries.name: Grail Lamp
entries.description: Burns webs and thorns; lights censers. This flame clears terrain, not enemy HP.

entries.name: Petal Cloak
entries.description: Use while moving to leap a gap. Land on safe ground beyond the hole.

entries.name: Root Gauntlet
entries.description: Worn, not equipped. Press R beside a boulder to lift it; throw it for 4 HP.

entries.name: Thorn Bow
entries.description: Fires along your facing. Each arrow costs one shot and deals 2 enemy HP.

entries.name: Drain Cap
entries.description: Equip and use it to return to the Drain. The way home waits beneath your feet.

entries.name: Map of the Wood
entries.description: Reveals every room's shape on the map. Discover features to learn their marks.

entries.name: Astrolabe
entries.description: Adds chests, the Heart and barriers to the map. Brass remembers the hidden ways.

entries.name: The Relic
entries.description: A precious thing from another chamber. Return it to the Weeping Nun.

entries.name: Piece of Heart
entries.description: Four quarters grow one whole heart. A little life is still worth finding.

entries.name: Heart Container
entries.description: Adds one heart to maximum health. One whole player heart holds 8 HP.

entries.name: Small Key
entries.description: Walk into a locked door to spend one key. A large keyhole shows its purpose.

entries.name: Heart
entries.description: A loose heart restores 8 HP: one whole player heart. Gather it by touch or sword.

entries.name: Gilt
entries.description: A little glimmer worth one gilt. Spend it at the frog's market in the Drain.

entries.name: Purse of Gilt
entries.description: A dropped purse holds 10 gilt. Larger chest rewards may hold more. Carry up to 999.

entries.name: Blightseed Refill
entries.description: A dropped refill adds three seeds if you own blightseeds. Carry up to 30.

entries.name: Arrow
entries.description: Adds one shot for the Thorn Bow. Walls stop arrows. Carry up to 50 shots.

entries.name: Five Arrows
entries.description: A small tied bundle adds five shots. Ammunition never exceeds 50.

entries.name: Ten Arrows
entries.description: A full bundle adds ten shots. The frog sells these once you have a bow.

entries.name: The Grail
entries.description: The Heart releases this when it falls. Claim the Grail to finish the journey.

entries.name: Healing Petal
entries.description: The frog's preserved snack costs 10 gilt and restores two player hearts.

entries.name: Coin Toad
entries.description: Scuttles toward nearby prey. Keep room to swing; a normal sword hit defeats it.

entries.name: Quill Moth
entries.description: Rests, then flies after you. Watch its body and shadow; strike when it comes close.

entries.name: Trumpet Bellflower
entries.description: Pauses and points before spitting. Step out of its lane or bat a seed back.

entries.name: Pear Bladder
entries.description: Compresses before a hop. Give the landing space, then close in for two sword hits.

entries.name: Moth Confessor
entries.description: A heavy blade follows a visible windup. Dodge the strike, punish recovery. Five sword hits.

entries.name: Blight Heart
entries.description: A split purple heart. Its pulse becomes spores, minions and lunges as its strength fades.

entries.name: Gilt Leech
entries.description: Compresses, locks a lane, then charges straight. Sidestep the rush and punish its recovery.

entries.name: Root Maw
entries.description: A mound announces emergence. Buried and rising bodies reject hits; strike while exposed.

entries.name: Reliquary Snout
entries.description: Its brass front blocks hits. Dodge the committed rush and strike a soft side or rear.
